Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
1.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: 2.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the husband, who has been falsely implicated in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that by the efflux of time, trial began and during the trial, the statement of P.W.1, P.W. 2 and P.W.3 were recorded and they have not supported the prosecution version, copy of their statements are annexed as Annexure-12, 13, 14 to the affidavit accompanying the bail application.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: He thus submits that no offence against the applicant is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed before the Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been mentioned.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text:
It has also been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45198977/
1 with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required and is also ready to accept all the conditions which the Court may deem fit to impose upon him.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: He next submits that applicant is languishing in jail since 29.11.2021, having no criminal history.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: 3. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that the innocence of the applicant cannot be adjudged at pre trial stage, therefore, he does not deserve any indulgence.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence, and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence the bail application is allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

A.

sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 17 October, 2023.json

Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Daga,Vipul Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mukesh Joshi Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
1-Heard Mr. Amit Daga, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Deepak Mishra, learned Additional Government Advocate assisted by Mr. Kamal Kumar, learned Brief Holder representing the State and Mr. Mukesh Joshi, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the first informant / complainant.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 2-By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Vineet, who is involved in Case Crime No. 124 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, police station Rajabpur, district Amroha seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
3-As per the prosecution case in brief, complainant Manoj Kumar, who is father of Tanishka (deceased) lodged an F.I.R. on 10.6.2022 for the offence under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act against Vineet Kumar (present applicant), Jagpal, Smt. Geeta,
Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180508886/
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 1 Nishu and Gulshan, who are husband, father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law and brother-in-law of the deceased respectively making allegations inter-alia of harassment and torture of his daughter by the accused persons, adopting different modus-operandi, in her matrimonial home on account of non-fulfilment of their additional demand of bolero car and bullet motorcycle in dowry.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: F.I.R. also alleges that on account of non-fulfilment of their demand of dowry, his daughter was done to death on 10.06.2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4-Main substratum of arguments of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is husband of the deceased and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The applicant has been languishing in jail since 11.06.2022 but till date, his trial has not been concluded, therefore, he may be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: In support of his contentions, he has also placed reliance upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of In re - Inhuman Conditions in 1382 prisons, 2024 SCC OnLine SC 3596.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: No other point has been pressed.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
5-On the other hand, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant/
complainant vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that the deceased died her unnatural death on 10.06.2022 in her matrimonial home within two years of her marriage solemnized on 27.12.2020.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: In the post mortem report of the deceased, six injuries in the nature of contusion and abraded contusion were found on different part of her body, which itself indicate that it is a case of extreme cruelty.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: He further pointed out that viscera was also preserved and the same was sent to FSL, in which "organochloro insecticides poison" has been found.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The prosecution witnesses who have been examined till date before the trial Court have supported the prosecution case.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Under the facts and evidence on record, the presumption under Section 113B of the Evidence Act shall also be drawn against the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Reliance has also been placed upon the judgments of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Shabeen Ahmad Vs. The State of U.P. and another, 2025 SCC OnLine SC 479 and 'X' vs. State of Rajasthan and another, 2024 SCC OnLine SC 3539 by contending that since the offence is heinous in nature and trial of the applicant is in progress, therefore, bail application of the applicant is liable to be rejected.

sentences.text: 6-Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that vide order dated 22.01.2025 of this Court, a report was called for from the concerned Presiding Officer/trial Court with regard to present status of trial of the applicant, whereupon the trial Court submitted its report dated 03.02.2025, which is on record, mentioning therein that now only three prosecution witnesses are remained to be examined and, as such, it is clear that trial of the applicant is at the advance stage.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The applicant being husband of the deceased was not only responsible for the safety and welfare of his wife, but also under heavy onus to explain her unnatural death, which took place in his own house.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: There is no plausible explanation of injuries found on the body of the deceased.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: In viscera report "organochloro insecticides poison" has been found.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The offence is heinous in nature.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Since the allegation of the prosecution and the defence of the accused are still open to be urged before the trial court, therefore, this Court in exercise of powers under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is not examining the statement of prosecution witnesses recorded before the trial Court meticulously, so that it may not affect the merits of the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
So far as judgment of the Apex Court in the case of In re - Inhuman Conditions in 1382 prisons (supra) is concerned, I find that there is no dispute about the proposition of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court but the said judgment is Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180508886/
2 distinguishable on the facts of this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: This Court is of the view that every case turns on its own facts.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Even one additional or different fact may make a big difference between the conclusion in two cases, because even a single significant detail may alter the entire aspect.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 7-Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the submissions advanced on behalf of parties, gravity of offence, role assigned to applicant, severity of punishment, stage of trial as indicated above and other attending circumstances, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 8-Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 9-It is made clear that the observations contained in the instant order are confined to the issue of bail and shall not affect the merit of the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vineet vs State Of U.P. on 6 March, 2025.json
